title: Solutions Consultant, Commercial, France
description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how enterprise software is sold and the Solutions Consultant is the cornerstone of that model. As a SC, you’ll own the full customer journey: from first meeting through workflow design, commercial close, workflow implementation, expansion & renewal planning. You are the single owner of your accounts, accountable for ensuring what you sell actually gets realized. You’ll build live in front of customers, translate workflow designs into commercial outcomes, and be a trusted partner with genuine continuity across the entire relationship. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Own the full customer lifecycle—new logo, expansion, and renewal—as the single account owner for your book of business, with responsibility for ensuring credits sold translate into credits consumed

title: Founding Sales Development Representative 🇩🇪
description:
📍 Berlin | Full-time | Fluent 🇩🇪& 🇬🇧
 E-commerce is booming — but independent brands still struggle to match the seamless logistics of giants like Amazon. At Bigblue , we’re on a mission to change that.
 We help brands by democratizing best-in-class operations: scaling faster while delivering a five-star customer experience.
 Since 2018, we’ve built a tech-driven logistics platform powering 600+ brands — from fast-growing DTC players to global names like MUJI, Aigle, and Cabaïa . With 130+ employees across Paris, Madrid, and London , our proprietary WMS (Warehouse Management System) Atlas , and a network of 10 warehouses across Europe , we’re solving logistics challenges that others haven’t dared to tackle — making fulfillment faster, smarter, and greener .
 Backed by $20+M in funding and trusted by the next generation of e-commerce leaders, we’re scaling rapidly — from 10 million orders in 2024 toward ambitious enterprise expansion. The journey ahead is bold, and we’re looking for the right partner to help us lead the way.
 About the role 🚀
 As a first Sales Outbound Expert in the German market, you will have the opportunity to shape this newly created role and establish your career path. This pioneering position allows you to lay the groundwork for our presence in Germany and play a crucial role in our growth strategy.
 🧑‍💻 Market insight
 - Serve as the key observer and analyst for the German market, providing valuable insights into emerging trends, competitive landscape, and customer preferences.
 - Collaborate closely with the Growth, Marketing, and Partnerships team to identify and research relevant sales targets within specific verticals and customer segments.
 🕵️ Prospect engagement
 - Conduct thorough research to understand the personal interests and professional needs of our target prospects. Our champions and decision-makers do not have any secret for you.

title: Content & Brand Intern (m/w/d)
description:
Was machen wir bei Sunpeak Capital?
 Rund 74 % aller CO₂-Emissionen in Deutschland entstehen im Zusammenhang mit der Energieproduktion, das sind über 543 Millionen Tonnen pro Jahr.
 Um die europäischen Klimaziele zu erreichen, müssen wir dieses Problem dringend und entschlossen angehen und genau hier setzen wir bei Sunpeak Capital an.
 Wir machen den Ausbau erneuerbarer Energien investierbar und verwandeln Photovoltaik, Batteriespeicher und Ladeinfrastruktur in renditestarke, steueroptimierte Investments. Unser Ansatz verbindet Klimaschutz mit finanzieller Intelligenz: Ein echtes Win-Win für Umwelt und Investoren.
 Mit unserer Kombination aus spezialisierten Beratungsprozessen, innovativen Investmentstrukturen und einem breiten Netzwerk aus Projektentwicklern ermöglichen wir privaten und unternehmerischen Investoren, den Energiewandel aktiv mitzugestalten, profitabel und nachhaltig.
 Wir skalieren unser Modell konsequent innerhalb Deutschlands, dort, wo die Energiewende entschieden wird. Werde Teil unseres Teams und trage dazu bei, dass Kapitalströme dorthin fließen, wo sie größten Klimanutzen und echte Rendite erzeugen.
 Aufgaben
 Deine Rolle
 Du prägst, wie Sunpeak Capital nach außen auftritt. Du verantwortest unseren Content von der Idee über den Dreh mit unserem Gründer bis zur Veröffentlichung und ziehst unsere Brand durch alle internen und externen Materialien. Dabei hast du viel kreativen Freiraum und bekommst die Tools, die du dafür brauchst.
 Aufgaben
 Du entwickelst unsere Brand weiter: Wie klingt Sunpeak, wie sieht Sunpeak aus, was macht uns wiedererkennbar? Das erarbeitest du mit den Foundern und ziehst es konsequent durch alle Touchpoints, von Social Media über Investorenmaterialien bis zu internen Präsentationen.
 Du verantwortest unseren Video-Content: Konzeption von YouTube-Videos, Podcasts und Social-Media-Formaten, Drehs mit unserem Gründer (Setup, Kamera, Ton, Regie) sowie Schnitt und Postproduktion inklusive Motion Graphics, Untertiteln und Thum…
